listing.name: lpc editor
listing.summary: adds an lpc editor that allows you to edit your wings to put custom weapons on it to edit a wing you need to have a few conditions respected:
listing.aiSummary: Adds an interface to edit carrier wings and assign custom weapons from cargo.

description: Allows players to modify existing wing loadouts by selecting slots and equipping weapons held in cargo. It also provides a fabricate button to create new wing variants using retool chips.
